EmailTemplate.subject: You’re almost there with your ila account!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
You’re almost there! Dear {!Case.Contact_First_Name__c},
Thank you for your interest in opening an account with ila.
In order for us to complete your on boarding process and open your account, we require you to please submit the following additional documents by replying to this email.
One of our agents may call you for further details or additional documents are required.
• Copy of your Jordanian ID
• Resident Permit
• Utility bill OR tenancy contract OR Bank statements.
• Latest bank statement for the last 3 months OR salary slips for the last 3 months OR letter of employment.
If you have mentioned yourself as self-employed OR business owner, please note to submit the following additional documents via email
• A copy of valid commercial registration certificate
• A copy of latest 3 months personal bank statements
In some cases, you may be required to participate in a video call or we may request you to visit our service center (TBD) to complete the onboarding process.
Should you require any additional information please call us at +96265100001
We are available 24/7
We eagerly await to welcome you to the ila family!
{! Receiving_User.Name}، ة/السيد
